newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues second set of rules on auditing.
newsitem.headline: China issues second set of rules on auditing.

text.p: China has promulgated a second set of rules on the auditing of listed firms, ordering accountants to make objections to firms issuing unrealistic profit forecasts, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.
The rules, which are effective from January 1, also require accountants to warn listed firms about possible management errors and to make proposals on risk control, the newspaper said.
"Registered accountants who find profit forecasts by listed companies to be unrealistic must clearly tell the firm and require it to make corrections," the rules say.
China's first set of rules on the auditing of listed firms came into effect on January 1 last year.
"The promulgation of the second set of rules is aimed at further standardising the activities of certified accountants," the newspaper said.
